ns0:svg.ns0:title: Periodic diffusion with OP System and OP Engine
ns0:svg.ns0:desc: A 64-cell periodic diffusion field and profiles at four times, computed from an OP System specification with RK4 integration in OP Engine. Spatial discretization is supplied explicitly; all inputs are synthetic.
